form.title: New Addon Domain
form.hint: Addon domains use their own document root. Parked domains share the parent domain document root.

www.title: Canonical Hostname
www.hint: Choose which hostname the site answers on. The other one returns a 301 to it, so search engines and links settle on a single address.
www.wwwUnresolved: www does not resolve to this server yet, so redirecting to it would take the site offline.
www.certMissingTarget: The certificate does not name this hostname, so the redirect is not in force yet. It starts working on its own once the certificate covers it.
